# El I Chingón

> I Ching consultation with AI interpretation. Radical privacy: no login, no tracking. Installable PWA. Open source.
> Consulta del I Ching con interpretación por IA. Privacidad radical: sin login, sin rastreo. PWA instalable. Código abierto.
> I Ging Beratung mit KI-Interpretation. Radikale Privatsphäre: kein Login, kein Tracking. Installierbare PWA. Open Source.

## English

### Canonical Documents
- [Constrained Stochastic Hermeneutical Computing: A Kinesthetic-Entropy I Ching Protocol](https://elichingon.com/en/articles/i-chingon-whitepaper/): The whitepaper of the CSHC protocol. Technical foundation of the project.
- [Hexagram 1 of this project - Why was El I Chingón born?](https://elichingon.com/en/articles/hexagram-1-why-el-ichingon-was-born/): Genesis of the project.
- [The Mountain and the Innocent Hand: On the Right Attitude Toward the I Ching](https://elichingon.com/en/articles/i-ching-right-attitude/): Philosophical framework.

### Application
- [I Ching Oracle Consultation](https://elichingon.com/en/iching-consultation/): Interactive oracle.
- [Source code repository](https://github.com/ichingon/ichingon.github.io): Canonical texts and source code.

### Articles
- [Chance, Science and the I Ching](https://elichingon.com/en/articles/chance-science-i-ching/)
- [The I Ching and the Self-Computing Universe](https://elichingon.com/en/articles/i-ching-and-the-self-computing-universe/)
- [The ABC of the I Ching](https://elichingon.com/en/articles/the-abc-of-the-i-ching/)
- [Is the I Ching the First Meme in History?](https://elichingon.com/en/articles/is-the-i-ching-the-first-meme-in-history/)
- [I Ching Hexagram 11 and the First Principle of Tai Chi](https://elichingon.com/en/articles/tai-chi-and-the-11th-hexagram/)
- [The Numerical Bridge: Bach's Musical Architecture and the I Ching](https://elichingon.com/en/articles/bach-and-i-ching/)
- [What do the I Ching and the Japanese creation myth have in common?](https://elichingon.com/en/articles/i-ching-and-kojiki/)
- [Is Peking Opera linked to the I Ching?](https://elichingon.com/en/articles/i-ching-and-peking-opera/)
- [The Symbolism of Holy Week through the I Ching](https://elichingon.com/en/articles/symbolism-of-holy-week-according-to-i-ching/)
- [How to consult the I Ching using the coin toss method](https://elichingon.com/en/articles/how-to-consult-the-i-ching-using-the-coin-toss-method/)

### Related Works
  - [U.N.A. Matemáticas El Tigre](https://unamatematicaseltigre.blogspot.com/): Blog by the same author about mathematics, statistics, and complex systems applied to distance education (2011-present).
  - [Closing post: "Quince años después: hacia dónde ha evolucionado este blog"](https://unamatematicaseltigre.blogspot.com/2026/10/quince-anos-despues-hacia-donde-ha.html): Explains the evolution of the project.
  - [2016 Retrospective](https://unamatematicaseltigre.blogspot.com/2017/03/2016-retrospective.html): Essay on distance education, SEO, attention economy, Big Data, heutagogy, and the preponderance of the individual. Foundational reading for the project's philosophy.

## Español

### Documentos canónicos

### Trabajos relacionados
- [U.N.A. Matemáticas El Tigre](https://unamatematicaseltigre.blogspot.com/): Blog del mismo autor sobre matemáticas, estadística y sistemas complejos aplicados a la educación a distancia (2011-presente).
  - [Post de cierre: "Quince años después: hacia dónde ha evolucionado este blog"](https://unamatematicaseltigre.blogspot.com/2026/10/quince-anos-despues-hacia-donde-ha.html): Explica la evolución del proyecto.
  - [Retrospectiva 2016](https://unamatematicaseltigre.blogspot.com/2017/01/retrospectiva-2016.html): Ensayo sobre educación a distancia, SEO, economía de la atención, Big Data, heutagogía y la preponderancia del individuo. Lectura fundacional de la filosofía del proyecto.
  - [La Era de la Información: ¿Ilustración o Ignorancia?](https://unamatematicaseltigre.blogspot.com/2016/12/la-era-de-la-informacion-ilustracion-o.html): Ensayo de 2011. Manifiesto fundacional. Explora la relación entre información, conocimiento, sabiduría, atención y cognición.
